# engine_mark

地图里写左边的值，不写右边的英文说明。Write the left-hand value in the map, not the English description on the right.

| 值 Value | 说明 Description |
| --- | --- |
| acidcolor | Use custom acid color # (hex color code) |
| acidtitle | Use custom acid title |
| casual | Enable casual mode |
| dm_max_guns_on_spawn | Define how many weapons can be randomly given to player in DM/TDM modes during respawn |
| dm_slots_on_spawn | List of slots that can be randomly given to player in DM/TDM modes during respawn |
| fix_gun_desynchronization | Enable gun desynchronization fixes (MP only) |
| game2 | Alternative gameplay |
| gamescale | Change game scale |
| he_nades_count | Set start HE nades count (MP only) |
| hero1_guns | Spawn marine weapons |
| hero2_guns | Spawn Proxy weapons |
| hero2_guns_nades | Spawn Proxy weapons (only nades) |
| hero2_guns_nonades | Spawn Proxy weapons (no nades) |
| level_errors | Enable level trigger error reporting |
| meat | Force ragdoll disappearment |
| naive_hit_confirmation | Enable naive hit confirmation (MP only) |
| no_auto_revive | Disable AI revive |
| no_dying_weapon_drop | Disallow enemies occasionally dropping weapons when dying (HTML5 port only) |
| no_light_break | Disallow lamp destruction and collisions |
| no_quick_save | Disallow manual quick saving on a level (HTML5 port only) |
| no_rail_bounce | Disable laser wall bounce (HTML5 port only) |
| no_unstable_weapon_drop | Disallow enemies occasionally dropping weapons when unstable (HTML5 port only) |
| nobase | Disable base noise |
| nopsi | Disable psi-swords |
| port_nades_count | Set start Port nades count (MP only) |
| sh_nades_count | Set start Shield nades count (MP only) |
| shadowmap_size | Shadowmap size |
| sky | Change sky |
| snow | Enable snow on map |
| strict_casual | Enable strict casual mode |
| var_sync | Enable Var Sync trigger actions |
| watercolor | Use custom water color # (hex color code) |
| watertitle | Use custom water title |
